author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Use Claude AI as an add-in for Microsoft Word, so you can save hours and create your best documents. In this tutorial, I’ll show how to enable Claude inside of Microsoft Word, then use Claude to draft new documents, analyze information, and safely modify documents. This video also shows how to reference additional files to rewrite documents in Word. 

With Claude, you have a new AI workflow for the Microsoft 365 Productivity applications. Copilot is no longer the only option. But, I’ll compare features between Copilot and Claude, exploring the advantages of using Claude, and identifying some scenarios where Copilot might be the best choice. 

Host: Nick Brazzi
